adapterExtraction.scope: Restricted-grammar path enumeration of the emitted bend_extract_effect/bend_extract_effects bodies against a schema-derived extraction specification, for the given adapter artifact only
established: Both bodies consist only of the accepted statement forms; every token is accounted for.

Single function: the whole slot is zeroed before any other statement, so every slot member is initialized on every return (success or failure); every later write is an assignment to a named scalar member or a four-byte write_le inside a named byte array of the same slot object.

Single function: for every well-formed input the function returns 1 and the slot equals the schema-derived mapping of the input variant (opcode, scalars, key limbs, 64-bit amount, zero elsewhere); every return of 0 is explained by a tag or Bool outside its declared domain.
Single function: a union member of a multi-variant value is read only after its tag was compared equal.

Plural function: on return 1 every declared slot is either extracted from its schema-derived source by a successful bend_extract_effect call or, for a vector, zeroed when its index is not below the length; slot indices are constants below the slot count; record tags and the length bound are guarded.
adapterExtraction.runtimeConventions: active: 0 none, 1 transfer (plain or bound), 2 check-mint, 3 mint, 4 burn; recipient: 0 actor, 1 custody, 2 explicit key; authority: 0 actor, 1 custody (mint is pinned to custody, burn to actor); source_bound/destination_bound: 0 any, 1 exact key; keys are eight little-endian 32-bit limbs a..h; amount = lo | hi << 32.

dependencies.layoutBasis: Derived from reviewed declarations under natural alignment of 8/32/64-bit unsigned types
dependencies.writeLe: exact body audited; summarized as p[i] = (u8)(v >> 8*i) for i < n

preconditions: The input is a well-formed checked native value of the schema type: every ADT tag is a declared variant tag, every Bool is 0 or 1, and the union member of the tagged variant holds initialized fields. Behavior on a malformed tag or Bool is reported only where the emitted code was found to reject it (guardedTerms); the terms listed under uncheckedTerms are read without validation and rely on this precondition.

`value` points to a valid readable object of the recorded native type and `out` to a valid writable slot object (plural function: an array of at least `slots` slot objects). Input and output objects are disjoint.
unsigned char/unsigned int/unsigned long long are 8/32/64 bits (asserted by the audited headers).
limitations: Not a C semantics: the grammar, the abstract interpreter, the integer-conversion rules it admits and the schema-to-typedef bridge are trusted, reviewed code. The checker itself is not verified.
Clang/LLD/SBF preservation, stack use and compute budget are out of scope.

Only extraction is covered. Custody setup, effect validation/execution, syscalls, CPI and the adapter entrypoint (including how it calls extraction and whether it reads slots after a failed extraction) are not.
On a FAILED extraction only the single function guarantees an initialized slot; the plural function may leave later slots unwritten. Callers must not read slots after failure.
Whether the opcode/field conventions match what token.h/bend_cpi.h validation and execution expect is pinned here by review of those headers (RUNTIME_CONVENTIONS), not proved.
Macro interference is excluded only for macros defined in the recorded include closure; command-line definitions are assumed absent.
adapterExtraction.trustedBridge: Exact reviewed text (conformance): slot struct typedefs in token.h/bend_cpi.h, write_le and the integer typedefs in solana_min.h, bend_u32, and one schema-generated typedef per native type reachable from the effects type. write_le(p, v, n) is summarized from its audited body as p[i] = byte i of v for i < n. Parsed and interpreted: every token of both extraction bodies.
